title: DriftSense sealed-set pre-registered evaluation protocol
preamble: This document is PRE-REGISTERED before the sealed set is run. It fixes the arms, metrics, confidence-interval method, decision thresholds, engine revision, dataset seed, and exact reproduction commands. It is frozen by sha256 (see 'hash') and tagged protocol-v1. Running the sealed set happens ONCE, in a separate session, via the entry point named below; this document neither reads, lists, generates, nor runs the sealed set.

engine.note: All v2 arms MUST run against exactly this commit. The grader records the running git_sha into each results file (ResultsFile.git_sha) and MUST refuse to grade if it differs from engine.git_sha.

dataset.name: sealed
dataset.access_rule: Only eval/sealed_run.py may read/list/download sealed data, and only when a human sets DRIFTSENSE_ALLOW_SEALED=1. The sealed set is run exactly once.
dataset.note: Tier and family labels come from the sealed manifest produced by the same generator (config.py TIERS, contracts.LatticeType). 'unknown' family and any tier not listed here are reported but excluded from per-family / per-tier decision rules.

ci.description: Wilson score interval for a binomial proportion.
applies_to: agent arm success / false-commit / escalation rates
ci.continuous_summary: For continuous metrics (subpixel nm error) report median and p95 with a 95% CI by BCa bootstrap (10000 resamples, seed 9999).

metrics.name: per-tier top-1 localization accuracy
metrics.definition: Fraction of pairs whose rank-1 candidate center falls within the ground-truth template window (same hit test as eval/gate_g2.py _hit).

metrics.name: per-family top-1 localization accuracy
metrics.definition: Top-1 hit rate stratified by LatticeType family.

metrics.name: pooled top-1 localization accuracy
metrics.definition: Top-1 hit rate over the full sealed set.

metrics.name: set-recall (candidate generation)
metrics.stratification: per tier; headline pooled over structured_tiers
metrics.definition: Fraction of pairs where the ground-truth location appears in the returned candidate set (within budget.max_candidates). Not recall@20; this is generation set-recall as defined in eval/gate_g2.py.

metrics.name: false-confident rate
metrics.definition: Fraction of pairs that COMMIT (Margin.decision == 'commit', i.e. margin >= tau) AND whose rank-1 is wrong. This is the quantity the active-perception agent exists to reduce.

metrics.name: expected calibration error
metrics.definition: ECE of Margin.p_correct against the top-1 correctness label, equal-count binning, as in eval/calibration.py.

metrics.name: subpixel localization error
metrics.stratification: pooled over structured_tiers; reported per tier
metrics.definition: Euclidean distance between committed Offset (x_nm, y_nm) and ground truth, over pairs that COMMIT. Requires Offset.pixel_size_nm present.

metrics.name: agent-arm success rate
metrics.definition: Episode ends with a correct commit within the dose/step budget (eval/agent_eval.py grading).

metrics.name: agent-arm false-commit rate
metrics.definition: Episode commits but the committed location is wrong.

metrics.name: agent-arm escalation rate
metrics.definition: Episode escalates to a human / abstains instead of committing.

metrics.name: agent-arm mean acquisitions
metrics.definition: Mean number of SEM acquisitions (re-images) per episode.

metrics.name: agent-arm mean electron dose
metrics.definition: Mean cumulative electron dose per episode (VirtualSEM accounting).

arms.name: NCC baseline
arms.definition: Single-scale normalized cross-correlation (OpenCV matchTemplate, TM_CCOEFF_NORMED) over the raw search frame; rank candidates by correlation peak. No lattice rectification, no calibration (never commits under the margin rule; false_confident is reported as n/a).

arms.name: v1 golden reference
arms.definition: Frozen v1 engine (tag v1-munichtech, driftsense/v1/), lattice path. Primary accuracy baseline. Compared like-for-like per the G2 notes (NCC-path, tier-pooled; sign-agnostic orientation).

arms.name: v2 single-shot
arms.definition: One v2 localize per pair at the pinned engine SHA, commit iff Margin.decision == 'commit'. Headline accuracy/calibration arm.

arms.name: active-perception agent (offline rules policy)
arms.definition: Full active-perception runner with the offline rules policy; re-images while margin < tau up to the dose/step budget, then commits or escalates. Arms share the identical first search frame with v2_single (eval/agent_eval.py convention).

arms.name: v2 ablation ladder
arms.definition: v2 with one capability removed per rung, to attribute accuracy/calibration to each stage. Each rung is graded on the same metrics as v2_single (top-1 pooled + per-tier, set-recall, false-confident, ECE, subpixel).

rungs.removes: S5-S6 cascade (FAST path only, no AUTO re-score)
isotonic calibration + Wilson tau (fixed tau from Budget, p_correct unset)
everything above the bare lattice detect+rectify core

rules.requires: v2_single top1.pooled Wilson 95% lower bound >= (v1 top1.pooled point estimate - 0.02)
v2_single top1.pooled point estimate >= ncc top1.pooled point estimate + 0.10
for each tier in structured_tiers: v2_single top1.<tier> Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.85
for each family in families: v2_single top1.family.<family> Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.80
v2_single false_confident.pooled <= 0.02 AND its Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.05
v2_single subpixel_nm_error median <= 0.50 nm AND p95 <= 1.00 nm over structured_tiers
agent_rules false_commit <= 0.02 AND its Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.05
agent_rules success Wilson 95% lower bound >= v2_single success point estimate
agent_rules mean_steps <= 3.0 acquisitions AND mean_dose <= the per-episode dose budget recorded in the results env

decision.overall_pass: ALL of D1..D12 hold. Any failure is reported as-is; thresholds are frozen and MUST NOT be edited after protocol-v1 is tagged.
decision.multiplicity_note: Endpoints D1..D12 are a fixed pre-registered battery; no post-hoc metric, tier, family, or threshold may be added or changed after tagging. New analyses are exploratory and labeled as such.

preconditions: export DRIFTSENSE_ALLOW_SEALED=1   (human-set; required to touch sealed data)
commands: python -m eval.sealed_run --arm ablation --rung full --rung no_cascade --rung no_contour_subpixel --rung no_calibration --rung no_roughness_fusion --rung lattice_only --seed 9999 --protocol eval/protocol.json
outputs: results/sealed/<arm>.json  (ResultsFile schema driftsense.results/1; dataset='sealed'; git_sha must equal engine.git_sha; protocol_sha256 must equal this protocol's hash.value)
reproduce.note: eval/sealed_run.py is implemented in a separate PR/session. The grader stamps ResultsFile.protocol_sha256 with hash.value and refuses to run if the live protocol sha256 or the running git_sha disagree with this file.

hash.canonicalization: sha256 over json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True) of this file WITH the top-level 'hash' key removed, UTF-8 encoded. Line-ending / whitespace independent.
